briefdescription.para: The dmi_status enum represents the status of DMI transactions.

detaileddescription.para: The dmi_status enum is used to indicate the success or failure of DMI read and write operations. It provides a clear and concise way to communicate the status of the transactions.

simplesect.para: The dmi_status enum is a part of the SystemC Component (SCC) library.
